sources.title: Can I get a visa on arrival?
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: Türkiye's Foreign Ministry eVisa service publishes a current named list of citizens eligible for a visa at border entry points and expressly includes Mauritius.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If you meet the required criteria, you can obtain a visa on arrival.

sources.title: Embassy of Panama: immigration and visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Panamanian Government embassy page publishes a named no-visa visitor-country list and expressly includes Mauritius, separately from conditional third-country-document routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Visa Required: IF you are from any of the following countries ... Mauritius

policies.title: Mauritian ordinary passports: Türkiye visa on arrival
policies.summary: Türkiye's current government eVisa service expressly names Mauritius among countries whose eligible citizens can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Türkiye's live Foreign Ministry eVisa service names Mauritius among countries whose eligible citizens can obtain a visa on arrival.
The portal says required criteria apply; passport validity, fees, entry points, work, residence, special documents, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Mauritian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's current Embassy visitor schedule expressly includes Mauritius in its no-visa-required list.
conditions: The Embassy page states a maximum stay of three months for the named no-visa-required cohort.
The policy is limited to ordinary Mauritian passports and visitor travel; passport validity, onward travel, funds, work, residence, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.
